Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return Type E_ OK: The service has succeeded E_ NOT_ OK: The service failed Description Ecu M_ Set Clock sets the Ecu M clock time to the provided value. This API is useful for testing the alarm services; Alarms that take days to expire can be tested. Ecu M_ Set Clock is part of the ECU Manager Module port interface. Available via Ecu M.h
